daily_kpi: The 2026-11-27 minimum was already met by the distinct ETF-relative-flow and BTC blockspace-fee-rate real-data screens; this is an additional hypothesis backtest.
data_scope: FRED ICSA weekly 2017-08-19 to 2026-11-21 (484 observations); Binance BTCUSDT Spot 1d UTC 2017-08-17 to 2026-11-25 (3388 candles, 136 checksummed archives); weekly events; validation 2019-2021; test 2022 onward

BTCUSDT.endpoint: Binance Vision official Spot 1d UTC kline archives

ICSA.revision_policy: current FRED vintage; historical ALFRED vintages not reconstructed
ICSA.source: U.S. Employment and Training Administration via FRED
ICSA.vintage: current FRED vintage; historical ALFRED vintages not reconstructed

disposition: INCONCLUSIVE — evidence is mixed, statistically uncertain or insufficient under the frozen rule

event_construction.event_frequency: weekly; five-session target windows must not overlap

limitations: FRED ICSA is current-vintage data; historical ALFRED vintages and exact historical publication timestamps were not reconstructed. The seven-day lag is conservative but does not eliminate revision look-ahead.
ICSA measures weekly initial unemployment-insurance claims, not layoffs alone, unemployment stocks or real-time labor-market expectations.
The feature is one four-week log change in a single national series; no alternative transformations, lags, series or parameters were tested.

This is one of many exploratory repository hypothesis screens; nominal paired-loss intervals do not correct for repository-wide multiple testing or selection bias. Any promising result requires independent confirmation.
BTCUSDT is one venue's Spot close. Binance archive checksums establish file integrity, not exchange-independent consolidated prices.
This is a forecast-only screen, not an executable strategy, trading P&L, causal claim or live deployment recommendation.
No raw ICSA observations or raw BTC price rows are committed; the manifest contains source hashes, coverage and derived forecast rows only.

methodology.availability: ICSA observation date is weekly ending Saturday; signal is the BTC UTC daily close exactly seven calendar days later
methodology.predictor: 100 * ln(ICSA[w] / ICSA[w-4]); positive means initial claims rose over four weekly observations
methodology.target: log1p(mean(min(next-five BTC daily log return, 0)^2) * 10000; downside semivariance in percent-squared units)
methodology.training_rule: latest 104 prior events whose signal date and five-session target end are both strictly earlier than the current signal
